Privacy and data requests

Updated 5 November 2026. Scope: this portfolio website, not the separate product applications.

Controller and contact

Erol Taşcı operates this site under the Voyagerroc Technologies brand. Contact: erol@voyagerroctechnologies.com.

Visits and preferences

Cloudflare processes technical connection data, including IP addresses, to deliver and secure the site. Necessary, proportionate delivery and security processing is assessed under KVKK Article 5(2)(f); specific legal obligations under Article 5(2)(ç). Optional analytics is disabled. No analytics decision is required to read the site. Language selection can use sessionStorage in the current tab. A previous privacy choice may remain for its original 180-day lifetime.

Enquiries

The project brief is prepared in browser memory. It is not submitted or saved automatically. Sending email shares the information with our Google email service. General enquiries are assessed under Article 5(2)(f), necessary contract enquiries under Article 5(2)(c). Do not send passwords, identity documents or unnecessary sensitive data.

Recipients, transfers and retention

Cloudflare and Google may process data outside Türkiye. The applicable KVKK Article 9 transfer mechanism requires separate verification; this notice is not an executed safeguard. Data should be retained only for the purpose and applicable legal requirements. Actual provider log and backup periods depend on service configuration. The detailed Turkish notices describe these limits.

Your rights

Under KVKK Article 11 you may request information, correction, erasure where applicable, notification to recipients, object to adverse results based solely on automated analysis, and seek compensation for unlawful processing. Contact the controller to arrange proportionate identity verification and a valid submission channel. Requests are handled as soon as possible, within 30 days. We have not published a postal or KEP address; those operational details remain to be completed. Read request procedures (Turkish) and storage details (Turkish).
